title.narrative: Improved coherence in support and action to facilitate just transitions towards environmentally sustainable economies and societies

description.narrative:
This global product reflects the Office’s contributions to the promotion and realization of a just transition and decent work in the response to the global environmental challenges of climate change, resource scarcity, loss of biodiversity, pollution, and the management of waste and chemicals.
In close collaboration between the Action Programme on just transition, the ILO policy departments, field offices and bureaux for workers’ and employers’ activities, the global product supports ILO Member States and national constituents in knowledge acquisition, capacity development and policy innovation in the transition towards green, blue and circular economies, keeping decent work, social justice, productivity growth, and poverty reduction as key outcomes.
The global product will further promote and monitor the uptake and application of the ILO tripartite Guidelines for a just transition towards environmentally sustainable economies and societies for all and interlinkages with relevant policy areas, particularly in the context of the development and implementation of Nationally Determined Contributions on climate change and other multilateral environmental agreements.
The global product will contribute to the preparation and organization of a tripartite dialogue with indigenous and tribal peoples, as mandated by the ILC in its discussion in 2023 on a just transition, including consideration of industrial policies and technology, towards environmentally sustainable economies and societies for all.
